exposure: mode of delivery (vaginal, elective cesarean, emergency cesarean)
cohort: 817 twin pregnancies delivered after 26 weeks at a tertiary teaching hospital between 1993 and 2008
finding: Maternal postpartum complications were higher in twin pregnancies delivered by emergency cesarean compared to elective cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: The occurrence of maternal postpartum complications was significantly increased in emergency compared to elective cesarean deliveries.
